hist.title: History

locate.tip: Click this number to locate the line in the image (click again to dismiss); the ⧉ button copies the line
main.editable_hint: Text is editable; copying and export use the edited content
main.empty_sub: Capture a full screen / region / active window with the buttons above, or drag on the preview to copy an area. A global hotkey and the tray menu work too.

picker.hint: Drag to select an area · ESC to cancel
sel.hint: Drag on the preview to copy an area · ESC to cancel
set.bad_regex: ⚠ {0} ignore rule(s) have invalid regex and will be skipped: {1}
set.close_hint: Clicking the window close button: hide to tray (stay in background) or quit the app
set.effect_tip: Tip: hotkey, HTTP port and frameless window apply the next time rumi-ui starts; theme/language apply immediately.

set.saved: ✅ Saved to config.toml (hotkey/port apply after restart)
set.sound_hint: Play a synthesized chime when recognition completes (silent if no audio device)

set.worker_ok: ✅ Saved; plugin worker restarted with {n} (if any)

sta.formula_warming: Warming up the formula engine… (first run downloads ~230 MB of models; OCR works meanwhile)
sta.hotkey_paused: ⏸ Global hotkey paused (tray menu → Pause hotkey to resume)
